current_point.claim: 提出了一种新的基于边分割的图流划分算法——Sketch-DBH，用于处理大规模图流数据下的子图划分问题。
current_point.claim_en: Proposed a new edge-segmentation-based graph flow partition algorithm, Sketch-DBH, for subgraph partitioning in large-scale graph stream data scenarios.
technical_features: 通过Count-Min Sketch 存储每个节点的度数信息
使用最小堆维护图流数据中的高频节点信息
根据节点度数信息生成子图编号
technical_features_en: Stored degree information of each node using Count-Min Sketch
Maintained high-frequency node information of graph stream data using a minimum heap
Generated subgraph IDs based on node degree information
